comments.text: Dean (2026-11-26, on the Add menu screenshot): clean up the main screen before the Silhouette editor. New, Open and Save go under File; Duplicate, Delete and the like under Edit; Undo and Redo under Edit too. Play is centred across the top with its own button, white when nothing plays and green while playing, with an orange Pause beside it while the game runs. He couldn't tell what most toolbar icons did; the magnet (snap) read as mute audio.
